name: Box of PAX Tampons
flavor: Promising protection and discretion, sanitary products like these are a luxury that few in the Lower Levels can afford.

name: Pack of Hemingway Cigarettes
flavor: The most luxurious smoking experience one can have, with a flavor, and a price tag, that makes sure you remember it.

name: Box of REX Condoms
flavor: Surprisingly common in the Lower Levels thanks to a subsidised distribution program. Population control, after all, is cheaper than riot control.

name: Bottle of 4 In 1 Wash
flavor: Shampoo, conditioner, body wash and toothpaste, all in one convenient bottle, with rejuvenating Nutrifruit extract.

name: Tube of Toothpaste
flavor: A minty gel that promises fresh breath.

name: Roll of Toilet Paper
flavor: Affordable toilet paper that offers strength and reliability. Two-ply is a luxury in the Lower Levels.

name: Water Testing Kit
desc: A small bottle of color strips used to test water quality.

name: Water Testing Strip
desc: A testing strip used to accurately determine the quality of a water sample.

name: AquaScan
desc: A device used to accurately determine the quality of a water sample. Displays detected impurities.

name: UV Lamp
desc: Can be used on a water container.
flavor: A lamp that emits ultraviolet light to kill bacteria and other microorganisms.

name: Scav Scanner
desc: A device that improves your chance of finding valuables when scavenging. (You can only benefit from one Scav Scanner at a time.)
flavor: Ever wanted a third eye? Or a second nose? Cut through the clutter with a Scav Scanner!

name: Gene Scanner
desc: Can be toggled on to reveal the full genetic makeup of an animal.

name: Bottle of Water Purification Tablets
desc: A small bottle of tablets used to purify water.

name: Water Purification Tablet
desc: Eliminate large amount of microbial contaminants and partially reduce chemical contaminants. No effect against other types of contaminants.

name: Water Filter
desc: Slightly improves water purity when used inside a filter system. Ineffective above a certain threshold.
flavor: A lightweight, consumer grade filter.

name: Advanced Water Filter
desc: Will recover 50 durability at the start of each day.
flavor: A premium water filter for pitchers used in the Upper Levels. Slowly self-cleans.

name: HydraTech Micro Water Purifier
desc: Use on a water container to bring its contents up to Basewater purity, whatever's in it. It will use 1 durability per 100ml.
flavor: A disposable advanced water purifier, common in the Upper Levels. The discarded ones wash up in the Dumping Grounds, still good for a few more pours.

name: Water Pitcher
desc: Holds a water filter to strip some contaminants from the water poured through it.

name: Hydroreed Filter
desc: Remove certain type of contaminants when used inside a filter system
flavor: A biological filter grown from Hydroreed.

name: Kotton Fabric
desc: Used in chemistry to strain large particles from liquids. Far too coarse for water purification.
flavor: A versatile fabric made of organic fibers. Commonly used for reinforced workwear and shock-insulating wraps.

name: Hydroponic Nutrient Tablet
desc: Contains minerals that are essential for plant growth. Can be added to a water container.
flavor: Do Not Consume. For hydroponic use only.

name: Hydroponic Nutrient Tablet Bottle
desc: A bottle containing hydroponic nutrient tablets
flavor: Do Not Consume. For hydroponic use only.

name: Lottery Ticket
desc: The winning numbers are revealed each Saturday morning.
flavor: A jackpot ticket could buy you a lifetime in the Upper Levels' safety and comfort.

name: Old Lottery Ticket
desc: A worthless ticket from the Lower Levels Lottery. No winning numbers, just faded hope.
flavor: A jackpot ticket could buy you a lifetime in the Upper Levels' safety and comfort.

name: ETERNAL Rejuvenation Serum
desc: A sought-after luxurious serum designed to rejuvenate and restore skin using ethically sourced stem cells.
flavor: A sleek glass jar containing a shimmering serum.

name: SYNC Neuroactive Perfume
desc: Use to boost trading bonus by 15% with the current customer. You can only benefit from the effects of one perfume at a time.
flavor: Developed from grief therapy research, this perfume use adaptive scent-mapping tech to evoke positive personal memories. Common in high-end hospitality venues, where workers found that the tips earned by wearing the perfume more than make up for the price tag.

name: SYNC Self-Refilling Neuroactive Perfume
desc: Use to boost trading bonus by 15% with the current customer. You can only benefit from the effects of one perfume at a time. Refills on its own.
flavor: The premium edition of the SYNC perfume. A sealed reservoir in the cap slowly synthesizes a new dose, so the bottle never quite runs dry.

name: L'ESSENCE Pheromone Perfume
desc: Use to boost trading bonus by 25% with the current customer. You can only benefit from the effects of one perfume at a time.
flavor: An illegal fragrance formulated from engineered human pheromones. It pushes attraction and emotional receptivity. Despite being illegal, it is highly sought after by social climbers in the Upper Levels.

name: Kotton Lining
desc: Kotton fabric made into padding. Provide modest protection to its wearer. Can protect against small arms if multiple layers are stacked.
flavor: Designed for workers in hazardous environment. Also an essential piece of equipment for scavs.

name: Backpack (Small)
desc: A compact, well-worn backpack with reinforced stitching. Lightweight but roomy enough for essential supplies.

name: Backpack (Army-Issue)
desc: A heavy duty backpack designed for military use. The fabric are very durable and some soldier wear it in the front to use it as additional armor when in battle.

name: Large Military Backpack
desc: A heavy duty backpack designed for military use. The fabric are very durable and some soldier wear it in the front to use it as additional armor when in battle.

name: Security Department Supply Crate
desc: A locked crate. Labeled for the Station Security Armory. Full of supplies. Access card required.

name: Security Department Evidence Locker
desc: A locked crate. Labeled for the Station Security Evidence Locker. Valuable. Access card required.
flavor: There's enough here to put the entire Lower Levels behind bars.

name: Medical Bay Supply Crate
desc: A locked crate. Labeled for the Station Medical Bay. Full of supplies. Access card required.
flavor: Surely these missing supplies won't cost anyone their lives... right?

name: Engineering Foundry Supply Crate
desc: A locked crate. Labeled for the Station Engineering Foundry. Full of supplies. Access card required.
flavor: Those hard hats will regret losing their tools...

name: Service Department Supply Crate
desc: A secure crate. Labeled for the Station Service Department. Full of supplies. Access card required.
flavor: The Station Service Department distributes utility supplies to those who need, or pay, for them.

name: Care Package for Eleanor
desc: A sealed crate of fine goods from the Upper Levels. Whoever packed it spared no expense. Strange, though: your Security feed lists it as reported stolen.

name: Expedition Supply Box
desc: Put supplies and equipments in this box for your hireling to use during expeditions. Unused gear will be returned to you.

name: Plastic Explosive
desc: Handle with care.

name: Armed Plastic Explosive
desc: This is what Lou planted. According to the timer, it will explode at midnight. You'd better disarm it.

name: Pilk
flavor: A carton of processed milk, or rather, a sweet, carbonated 'milk-based' beverage. Tastes better than you'd expect.

name: Puice
desc: A carton of processed juice. All the natural sugars have been extracted and replaced with refined sugars. Contains 0.1% real fruit juice!

name: Peat
desc: A can of salty processed meat made by Davre. It is cheap, available and filling. As long as one does not care about what type of meat it is made of.

name: Bottle of Spring Water
desc: A sealed bottle of water supposedly drawn from a natural spring on a distant planet untouched by any industrial activity.
flavor: No one in the Lower Levels would drink this, even if they were dying of thirst, such is its value.

name: Red Imp Beer
flavor: A popular beer brewed in the Lower Levels. Every batch tastes a bit different, but there is nothing cheaper. 3.5% ABV.

name: Empty Beer Bottle
desc: Not a drop left. To prevent waste, brewers typically offer some kind of "buyback" program for their bottles.

name: Liquid Luck
flavor: Will 100% increase your luck for 3 days! Georgio's guarantee! It tastes like Rustwater.

name: Bottle of Acidic Solution
desc: Can be used to clump Protein and Stabilizing Agent for easier filtering. Also counteracts bases.
flavor: Warning: Corrosive. Handle with care.

name: Bottle of Basic Solution
desc: Can be used to clump Protein and Stabilizing Agent for easier filtering. Also counteracts acid.
flavor: Warning: Caustic. Handle with care.

name: Bottle of N-Methylol Base
desc: A versatile chemical base used in many legitimate chemical manufacturing but also a common precursor for Phanta.

name: Bottle of Reducing Agent
desc: Essential for certain chemical reaction.
flavor: Donates electrons to another substance, changing the other substance's chemical state.

name: Bottle of Lipobond Agent
desc: Clump Oils and Fat together allowing them to be filtered off easily. This agent can then be evaporate off.

name: 1ml Dropper
flavor: A high-precision dropper for dispensing small amount of liquid.

name: Soda
desc: A sweet carbonated beverage. On some parts of the Station, it's cheaper than clean water.

name: Nudka
desc: A strong spirit made from Nutrifruit. Originally developed to be a heavy-duty paint stripper.

name: Galaxy Blend
flavor: A nutritious puree made from pastel Inc.'s Nutrifruit and fortified with additional vitamins and minerals. One of the healthiest, and least popular foods available in the Lower Levels.

name: Cat Chocolate Bar
flavor: A chocolate-covered wafer bar. Made to share, mostly eaten alone.

name: Li-Eat Snack Bar
desc: A high protein chocolate flavored candy bar.

name: Raw Meat (Small)
desc: A small piece of raw meat.
flavor: Fresh meat is a rare sight in the Lower Levels, where it comes from is of little interest to them.

name: Raw Meat (Standard)
desc: A piece of raw meat.
flavor: Fresh meat is a rare sight in the Lower Levels, where it comes from is of little interest to them.

name: Animal Fat
desc: A pound of suet. Cheap, and commonly used for rendering into tallow, or adding flavor to broths.

name: Offal
desc: Organs, entrails, cartilage and trimming. While comestible and nutritious, is considered undesirable by most cuisines.

name: Instant Ramen
desc: Contains a single use, flameless heater. Just add water for cooking.
flavor: Artificial Braised Beef Flavored. A certified Lower Levels classic. MSG, white pepper and Sichuan peppercorns give this instant noodle a spicy kick.

name: Sealed Water Ration (Standard)
desc: Can be poured into a liquid container for 750ml of Basewater.
flavor: A sealed and certified ration of Basewater.

name: Sealed Water Ration (Small)
desc: Can be poured into a liquid container for 375ml of Basewater.
flavor: A sealed and certified ration of Basewater.

name: Processed Cheese
flavor: Holes are drilled into the cheese for the classic look, whilst also cutting production costs.

name: Bei's Premium Vanilla Icecream
desc: Can be sold at a higher value when frozen overnight in the fridge.
flavor: A delicious treat that is legally categorized as Artificially Flavored Frozen Dairy Product. Somehow it doesn't melt when unrefrigerated.

name: Furnace
desc: Refines 2 pieces of either metal scrap or ores into a metal ingot. Requires Energy. Overnight.

name: Hydroponic System
desc: A compact hydroponic system. Requires a dedicated power source to function. Works overnight.

name: 3D Printer
desc: A machine that can print various items using plastic. Works overnight.

name: Recharger
desc: A device for recharging Energy Cell. Will slowly recharge an Energy Cell as long as the power service has been paid. Overnight.

name: PowerBloc
desc: Restores +2 power each night to adjacent Energy Cells, or Energy Cells inside adjacent Machines (excluding Recharger) as long as the Power Service is paid. This effect can be stacked.
flavor: A compact power source that can charge adjacent Energy Cells.

name: Makeshift Micro Nuclear Reactor
desc: Powers the Store while its integrity is above {0}. Loses integrity every night and explodes at 0. Scrap metal restores {1} integrity. Junk restores {2} integrity but lowers maximum integrity by {3}. Each common electronic part reduces the nightly loss by 1.

name: Alarm System
desc: Greatly reduces the chance of theft during the night. Requires a dedicated power source to function.
flavor: A smart security alarm system, equipped with a suite of sensors and connects to cameras installed by the previous owner.

name: Storage Coordinator
desc: Assign containers and machines to presets. Give each preset a hotkey to open them quickly.

name: Mirage Projector
desc: Requires a night to charge, but improves the street attractiveness of your Store on the next day.
flavor: A sophisticated device that emits captivating holographic projections, making your Store more attractive to customers.

name: Moisture Farm
desc: Produces Water when provided with a container. Requires Energy. Overnight.
flavor: A machine designed to extract Water from the humid ambient air of the Station.

name: Water Purifier
desc: Purifies the contents of an inserted Water container. Requires Energy. Overnight.
flavor: A machine that uses reverse osmosis to purify Water.

name: Cryptographic Desequencer
desc: Requires a Desequencer Chip and an Access Keycard. Requires Energy. Overnight.
flavor: Can be used to write various permissions to Blank Keycards.

name: Bottle Printer
flavor: A pre-programmed 3D printer that is capable of creating small Water Bottles.

name: Heating Plate
desc: A shabby looking underpowered and inaccurate heating plate.

name: Blender
desc: A flimsy looking blender

name: Evaporator
desc: A slow machine that works overnight to evaporate liquids out of a solution using low heat and dry air.

name: Chem Finisher
desc: Package chemicals into pills, vials and other containers.

name: Vending Machine
desc: Items will be sold at +10% additional value and with Retail Markup if applicable but is not affected by event related modifiers.
flavor: A vending machine that sells items automatically overnight.

name: Vending Fountain
desc: Items will be sold at +10% additional value and with Retail Markup if applicable but is not affected by event related modifiers.
flavor: A vending water fountain machine that sells water automatically overnight. Only Basewater, High Quality Water and Pure Water can be sold.

name: AgeWell
desc: Accelerates the aging process of certain items inside. Ages items such as Wine and Cheese by an extra day each cycle.

name: Fridge
desc: Chills stored drinks overnight. Chilled goods sell for more. Wine and unsealed water are unaffected.

name: Red Dot Sight
desc: A legacy compact red dot sight for quick target acquisition.

name: Makeshift Red Dot Sight
desc: A 3D printed RDS with a red LED and plastic lens. It is not very reliable, but it works surprising well.

name: Suppressor
desc: A simple multi-caliber suppressor that reduces the noise of gunfire, making it harder to detect.

name: Night Owl Suppressor
desc: A sophisticated multi-caliber suppressor that reduces the noise of gunfire, making it harder to detect.

name: Makeshift Suppressor
desc: A makeshift suppressor made from a plastic bottle and scrap metal.

name: Attachable Extended Barrel
desc: A multi-caliber extended barrel that improve bullet velocity and accuracy.

name: Compensator
desc: A muzzle device that reduce muzzle rise when firing by redirecting escaping gases

name: 10mm Magazine
desc: A 9 round compact 10mm magazine.

name: High Capacity 10mm Magazine
desc: A 14 round high capacity 10mm magazine.

name: Extended 10mm Magazine
desc: A 19 round extended 10mm magazine.

name: .22 Magazine
desc: A cheap 3D printed 12 round compact .22 magazine.

name: High Capacity .22 Magazine
desc: A cheap 3D 24 round compact .22 magazine.

name: Extended .22 Magazine
desc: A cheap 3D 48 round compact .22 magazine.

name: 10mm SMG Magazine
desc: A 20 round 10mm magazine specially made for the Peacemaker Heavy SMG.

name: 10mm High Capacity SMG Magazine
desc: A 35 round 10mm magazine specially made for the Peacemaker Heavy SMG.

name: 10mm SMG Box Magazine
desc: A 150 round 10mm magazine specially made for the Peacemaker Heavy SMG.

name: Laser Sight
desc: A simple laser sight that projects a beam onto the target, improving ergonomic.

name: Target Acquisition Device
desc: A smart tactical device that projects a beam onto the target based on various conditions.

name: Toy Laser Pointer
desc: A low powered toy laser pointer.

name: Bipod
desc: A bipod that can be attached to firearms, providing stability.

name: Underbarrel 25mm Grenade Launcher
desc: A compact 25mm underbarrel grenade launcher.

name: Guardian Stock
desc: A sturdy stock compatible with Meridian firearms, designed to improve recoil handling.

name: Buckler Stock
desc: A short stock compatible with Meridian firearms, designed to improve recoil control without sacrificing ergonomic.

name: High Durability Internal Springs
desc: A set of advanced internal springs that improve the cycling and resistance to failure under stress.

name: Improved Internal Springs
desc: A set of sturdier internal springs that help the action cycle reliably.

name: Tuned Trigger Group
desc: A trigger group that improves the trigger pull. Reduces trigger pull weight and creep.

name: Match Grade Barrel
desc: A high precision barrel that improves accuracy.

name: Pistol Auto Sear
desc: A special handgun mod. When installed, it alters the internal mechanics so that the gun fires continuously as long as the trigger is held down.

name: Ammo Display
desc: A smart display that shows the current ammo count and ammo type.

name: Tactile Memory Grip Gel
desc: Bio-reactive gel under grip surface conforms subtly to user's hand.

name: Liberator 3D Printed Pistol
desc: A low cost plastic 3D printed pistol.
flavor: Doesn't get cheaper than this. It's good for a few shots.

name: Nestfire Compact
desc: A small open-sourced pistol chambered in .22 SR
flavor: Widely used for home defence in the Lower Level. Mostly tolerated by Security. Probably handmade by a Lower Level gunsmith.

name: Ironcraft 10
desc: A heavy open-sourced pistol chambered in 10mm
flavor: Capable of piercing body armor. A popular weapon for Lower Level Revolutionary.

name: Sentinel Mk. III.
desc: A reliable handgun, chambered in 10mm. Mostly carried by Security

name: Peacemaker Heavy SMG
desc: A heavy SMG, chambered in 10mm. Used sparingly by Security during high stakes operations.

name: Rampart Dual-Action Shotgun
desc: A dependable and adaptable shotgun built for law enforcement, featuring a dual-action mechanism that ensures reliable performance with a wide range of ammunition types.

name: Lancewell Revolver
desc: A 5" general purpose Lancewell revolver chambered in .45 AFP.
flavor: A simple and highly reliable weapon. Designed to endure extreme conditions, while requiring minimum maintenance.

name: PulseGuard Stun Gun
flavor: A well made self-defence option officially endorsed by Security. Mostly used by Upper Level due to high cost.

name: .22 SR Ammunition
flavor: A handful of .22 SR ammo. While small, it still can be lethal at close range. Most importantly, it is very cheap.

name: .22 SR Ammunition (AP)
flavor: A handful of .22 SR Armor-Piercing ammo. Capable of piercing body armor.

name: .22 SR Ammunition (Non-Lethal)
flavor: A handful of .22 SR Non-Lethal ammo. Tip with rubber, it is designed to incapacitate.

name: 10mm Ammunition
flavor: A handful of 10mm ammo. Powerful and reliable, it is the standard round for heavy pistols.

name: 10mm Ammunition (AP)
flavor: A handful of high velocity 10mm Armor-Piercing Discarding Sabot (APDS) ammo. Capable of piercing body armor.

name: 10mm Ammunition (Non-Lethal)
flavor: A handful of 10mm Non-Lethal ammo. Tip with rubber, it is designed to incapacitate.

name: Tazer
flavor: A compact stun weapon used for self-defense and enforcement. Delivers a painful jolt.

name: Animal Cage
desc: A small cage for housing animals. Doesn't look particularly comfortable, but probably nicer than what some people have in the Lower Levels.

name: Livestock Feed Dispenser
desc: A machine that blends food into stored calories for livestock.

name: Auto Butcher
desc: A configurable auto butcher. It needs to be installed inside an Animal Cage or a RAS. Every night it harvests the animals that match its settings into its tray. It always ignores animals marked with the Marking Pen.
flavor: The mighty Gibber. Do not climb inside. Do not let anyone help you climb inside.

name: Marking Pen
desc: Marks an animal or a fish with a colour. The Auto Butcher never touches a marked animal.

name: Cleaner Robot
desc: Automatically collects Animal Feces from its surroundings during the night. Can also be activated manually for an immediate cleanup.

name: Livestock Steroid Serum
desc: Livestock Steroid Serum
flavor: Livestock Steroid Serum

name: Livestock Immunity Serum
desc: Livestock Immunity Serum
flavor: Livestock Immunity Serum

name: Mouse Trap
flavor: Putting some cheese inside will probably help.

name: Recirculating Aquaculture System
desc: A closed water loop for raising fish. Needs a water tank, power, and filters to keep the water clean.

name: RAS Water Tank
desc: The water reservoir of a recirculating aquaculture system.

name: Tilapia Skin Graft
desc: Sterilized skin of a graft tilapia. Stops the bleeding and closes a wound.

name: Gutterflow Pellet
desc: Pressed gutter sludge. Cheap calories for omnivore fish, not for people.

name: Industrial Fish Feed
desc: Mass produced factory-made feed for omnivore and herbivore fish.

name: Eel Fillet
flavor: A delicacy on the station.

name: Nutrifruit
desc: Created by pastel Inc., the Nutrifruit is a highly modified tuber that is resistant to pests and diseases. It is cheap, has a high yield and is easy to grow, extremely nutritious, but purposefully seedless.

name: Nutrifruit Seed
desc: A tuber, genetically modified to be hardy and fast growing. Requires nutrients and water to grow.

name: Kotton Fiber
desc: A modified variant of traditional Cotton. Can be woven into highly durable and versatile fabric

name: Kotton Seed
desc: A hard to grow seed that can be planted to grow more Kotton Fiber. It is a modified Cotton that can be woven into a durable fabric.

name: Dream Cap
desc: Cause a slight euphoria and stomach pain when consumed. A key ingredient in Dream Dust

name: Meal Cap
desc: A neutralized Dream Cap with no psychoactive properties. Legal and safe to eat. Cannot be processed into Dream Dust.

name: Nightmare Cap
desc: Highly poisonous variant of the common Dream Cap. Can be processed into a deadly poison. Survivors report having horrible hallucinations after ingesting it.

name: Plant Analyzer
desc: A specialized tool that can be used to analyse the growth of plants. It can be used to determine the optimal growing conditions for a plant.

name: Coffee Beans
desc: A handful of coffee beans.

name: Fillerweed
desc: A fast-growing, yellowish leafy crop cultivated primarily in the Lower Levels. Offers almost no nutritional value, it is used as a filler in meals to stretch rations
flavor: Has a mushy texture with a slightly bitter aftertaste.

name: Fillerweed Seed
desc: A beginner-friendly, fast-growing seed that is not affected by nutrient or water quality.

name: Hydroreed Seed
desc: A utility crops that produce no food. The Hydroreed will purify the water it is in while growing

name: Bloomberry Seed
desc: A perennial bush. It doesn't die after fruiting. Keep its water clean for better bloomberries. Use a hatchet on the planter to clear it.

name: Chemical Supplies (Common)
desc: Can be unpacked into items that are useful for basic chemical crafting.
flavor: A collection of common chemical supplies you could likely find in the Station Hardware Depot.

name: Chemical Supplies (Restricted)
desc: Can be unpacked into items that are useful for advanced chemical crafting.
flavor: A collection of restricted chemical supplies needed for crafting narcotics, or explosives.

name: Medical Supplies (Common)
flavor: A collection of common medical supplies, mostly over-the-counter pharmacy items.

name: Medical Supplies (Restricted)
flavor: A collection of restricted medical supplies, necessary for the care of the Station's infirm.

name: Scrap Metal
desc: Can be smelted into Metal Ore. With limited resources available on the Station, salvage and recycling are important habits.

name: Junk
flavor: Broken scraps and useless rubbish. Barely recyclable, worth next to nothing.

name: Electronic Parts (Common)
flavor: An assortment of all kinds of useful, if common, electronics: connectors, switches, capacitors, processors and processing units...

name: Electronic Parts (Rare)
flavor: An assortment of uncommon, high-end electronic parts. A certain inventor would be very interested in this...

name: Electronic Parts (Hypertech)
desc: Used to upgrade or charge certain Hypertech items.
flavor: The bleeding edge of electronics. Nobody on the station can make these.

name: Wire
desc: A bundle of electrical wires. From the looks of it, it was harvested from somewhere...

name: 3D Printing Filament
desc: A spool of premium filament for use in a 3D printer. Made from recycled plastics where possible.

name: Flux Smelting Agent (Basic)
desc: A useful additive that improves the purity of Metal Ore when used during smelting. It is consumed in the process.

name: Flux Smelting Agent (Advanced)
desc: A useful additive that improves the purity of Metal Ore when used during smelting. Reusable.

name: Gun Parts
desc: Obtained from disassembling firearm with a screwdriver. Can be used to refurbish used firearms. Repeated attempts will increase refurbish chance.
flavor: A collection of internal gun parts, including screws, springs, and other small components.

name: Radioactive Waste
desc: Radioactive waste material. Handle with care.
flavor: A collection of hazardous nuclear waste. No one wants to deal with this stuff.

name: Synaprest Injector
desc: Next-generation treatment for drug addiction, designed to suppress the brain's reward system, reduce cravings, and support long-term recovery
flavor: Works best with concurrent psychological therapy and social support.

name: Oxymore Injector
desc: Oxymore is a legal, but dangerous medication used to relieve severe pain and produce feelings of euphoria. Oxymore addiction and overdose are widespread due to over-prescription.

name: Nomore Injector
desc: A non-addictive alternative to Oxymore for pain relief. Provides effective analgesia without the risk of dependence or overdose. This one is a prototype packaged in a repurposed injector.

name: Immunivax Injector
desc: A high-precision immuno-regulator developed to temporarily suppress the hyper-reactive immune response associated with Sentinel Collapse.

name: Naloxgone Injector
desc: Naloxgone is a emergency medication used to counter Oxymore overdose.

name: Birth Control Pill
flavor: A contraceptive pill that prevents pregnancy. It's a combination of estrogen and progestin hormones.

name: Phanta Pill
desc: An extremely addictive, dangerous and cheap synthetic opioid drug used for treatment of severe pain.
flavor: More than 50 times stronger than Oxymore.

name: Phagimycin Pill
flavor: A powerful antibiotic made with bacteriophages and fungi to counter antibiotic resistance.

name: Unlicensed Phagimycin Pill
flavor: A powerful antibiotic. This one is made illegaly without license to the carmicheal's patent in an underground lab.

name: Zyanide Pill
desc: A fast-acting and deadly chemical compound. Handle with caution.

name: Smelling Salts
desc: A thin glass tube containing alcohol and ammonia that helps restore consciousness after fainting.

name: Basic Bandage
desc: A simple, clean bandage for dressing wounds.

name: Hemostatic Bandage
desc: A bandage coated with a potent hemostatic agent capable of stopping heavy and light bleeding.

name: Topical Medication Bandage
desc: A bandage coated with a mild topical medical gel that aids in the healing process.

name: Blood Bag
desc: A 500ml blood transfusion bag drawn from a universal, though not necessarily willing, donor.

name: Bag of "Blue Blood"
desc: An injectable biogel engineered to dissolve arterial plaque and microclots over time. It effectively prevents coronary artery disease, ischemic stroke and hypertension-related complications.
flavor: It's not actually blood. Not so common even in the Upper Levels.

name: Vial of "Dream Dust"
flavor: A cheap, euphoria inducing powder, created in the Lower Levels. Used as a brief escape from the harsh realities of Station life.

name: Vial of "Nightmare Dust"
flavor: A fine powder that acts as both a poison and a hallucinogen. Ingestion or inhalation causes severe nausea, weakness, and disorientation, followed terrifying hallucinations. High doses can be lethal.

name: Caffeine Pill
flavor: Synthesized from the waste of Upper Levels espresso bars, these pills are essential for the long shift workers of the Lower Levels.

name: Nightingale's Salve
flavor: Made from modified aloe and medical grade honey. This salve has antibacterial properties and promotes cell regeneration and growth.

name: Rubbing Alcohol
flavor: A potent disinfectant used for cleaning wounds and surfaces. Highly toxic if ingested, but that doesn't stop it being used as an alternative to Nudka in the Lower Levels.

name: ZeroChew Tab
desc: A tab of ZeroChew, an affordable appetite suppressant.
flavor: Used by some Lower Levels inhabitants looking to stretch their credits by skipping meals. Marketed as Regime-X, a weight loss drug in the Upper Levels.

name: Composition Spectrometer
desc: A device used to analyze the chemical composition of substances.

name: Surgery Toolset
flavor: A set of high quality surgery tools.

name: Kitchen Knife
flavor: A stainless steel knife. Keep out of reach of children and scheming Upper Levels Housewives.

name: Box Cutter
flavor: A sturdy utility knife with a retractable blade commonly used in construction, crafting and warehouse work.

name: Combat Knife
flavor: A fighting knife designed for military use and primarily intended for hand-to-hand or close combat fighting, but also useful for utility.

name: Combat Machete
flavor: A heavy-duty machete built for combat and survival.

name: Lead Pipe
desc: A heavy lead pipe. After the Station overhauled the water line, tonnes of leftover lead piping found its way into the hands of scavs and thieves.

name: Stun Baton
desc: Standard-issue stun baton with STUN and HARM modes. An everyday carry for Security Officers maintaining order in the station.

name: Crowbar
flavor: The trusty tool of every experienced scavenger and theoretical physicist on the Station. Useful as a weapon in a pinch.

name: Hatchet
desc: Small but sturdy. Can be used on a Hydroponic Farm to clear whatever is currently growing.

name: Glass Shiv
flavor: A sharp-edged piece of broken glass wrapped in cloth that can be used as a weapon.

name: Skinning Knife
flavor: The perfect knife for a veteran rancher.

name: Energy Cell
desc: A basic power source that is compatible with most machines. Rechargeable.
flavor: In an effort to reduce waste, single-use batteries were made illegal by the Republic.

name: Self Charging Energy Cell
desc: An advanced and rare energy cell capable of self charging

name: Energy Cell (Mk. II)
desc: An improved power source that is compatible with most machines. Rechargeable.
flavor: Improving on the standard model, the Mk. II cell is bigger, better and even more of a choking hazard.

name: Current Converter
desc: Draw power directly from the Lower Levels' grid to power any machine instead of a battery. The Current Converter nightly service must be paid in order to receive power.

name: Hypertech Power Cell
desc: An experimental cell with no stored charge. It powers any machine whose draw stays within the cell's output rating, indefinitely. Machines that draw more than the rating get nothing.

name: Security Record
desc: Your contact will keep this up to date
flavor: A copy of your security record file from the Security Department

name: Flashlight
desc: A heavy duty flashlight. While carrying this, you are less likely to be injured while scavenging in the Dumping Grounds.

name: Newspaper
desc: A fresh newspaper.

name: Mentor's Handbook
desc: A book for keeping track of all notes givien to you by The Mentor. Handy!

name: Hemingway Identification Guide
desc: A guide that helps identify counterfeit Hemingway Cigarettes.

name: Hemingway Color Checker
desc: An official Hemingway color swatch.

name: Plasma Cartridge Appraisal Guide
desc: A guide for determining the appropriate value of Plasma Cartridges.

name: Ribwich Appraisal Guide
desc: A handy guide that helps with determining the correct value of a Ribwich.

name: Food Stamp Identification Handbook
desc: A handy guide to identifying a genuine Food Stamp from a counterfeit.

name: Immunivax Assessment Guide
desc: Contains all the information you need to reliably assess the condition of Immunivax Injectors.

name: Water Trading Manual
desc: A handy manual that contains all the information on buying and selling Water.

name: Hydroponic Farming Manual
desc: A handy manual that contains all the information on hydroponic farming.

name: Chemistry Manual
desc: A handy manual that contains the basics of chemistry.

name: Deed
desc: The deed to the Store.

name: Old Republic Orders
desc: A yellowed, brittle sheet. It looks like it has been folded and unfolded many times. It's a written order addressed to Lou, dated years ago. A faded Republic seal is still visible at the top.
flavor:
REPUBLIC JOINT SPECIAL OPERATIONS COMMAND, PRIORITY ORDER
TO: Emergency Response Team Leader Lou

Stop stalling for time and carry out this order immediately. Take your team and start the self-destruct sequence of the research ship Icarus. Disable all the escape pods and do not allow any survivor from the Icarus to escape with your team. Do it, or I will have you court-martialed.

(The signature has faded beyond reading.)

name: Republic Logo Checker
desc: A reference for the Official Republic Logo.

name: Lease Agreement
desc: Your lease. Signed by you, and your Landlord.

name: Business Permit
desc: A permit issued by the Republic. Required to legally operate a business in the Lower Levels.

name: Handnote
desc: A simple note, written by hand.

name: Scavenger's Token
desc: A token given by the Scavenger community. Each token placed in the display case will increase the chance of a Scavenger visit.
flavor: A form of recognition.

name: Black Lamp
desc: When placed in the display case, it signals thieves that this shop fences stolen goods. Your Black Market reputation affects how likely they are to respond.

name: Dossier
desc: Can hold documents, notes, books and magnifying glasses.

name: Trash Can
desc: Items inside will be permanently removed at night if Janitorial Service is paid.

name: Water Drain
desc: Unwanted water can be dump here

name: Water Faucet
desc: No water... Maybe someone can help connect it to a water line?

name: Disposable Keycard (Command)
desc: A single-use keycard for Station Command. Can open most locks that require keycard access.
flavor: A master keycard, to be carried only by Station Command.

name: Disposable Keycard (Security)
desc: A single-use keycard for Station Security. Can open locks that require Security Department access.
flavor: Could be dangerous if this falls into the wrong hands...

name: Disposable Keycard (Research)
desc: A single-use keycard for Research and Development. Can open locks that require Science Department access.
flavor: Keycard carried by the Station's Research Officers. Valuable.

name: Disposable Keycard (Medical)
flavor: A single-use keycard for the Station's Medical Department. Can open locks that require Medical access.

name: Disposable Keycard (Engineering)
flavor: A single-use keycard for the Station's Engineering Department. Can open locks that require Engineer access.

name: Disposable Keycard (Supply)
flavor: A single-use keycard for the Station's Supply Department. Can open locks that require Supply access.

name: Disposable Keycard (Service)
flavor: A single-use keycard for the Station's Service Department. Can open locks that require Service access.

name: Disposable Keycard (Blank)
desc: An unwritten keycard. With the right machine, this can be reprogrammed with all kinds of access.
flavor: As close to a skeleton key as you'll find on the Station.

name: Business Card (Joe Wild)
flavor: At your service.

name: Business Card (Red Imp Brewery)
flavor: Fiendishly good.

name: Business Card (GP Mining Coop)
flavor: No one really know what GP stands for anymore.

name: Business Card (Pharmacist)
flavor: A very plain card with only a name and a phone number.

name: Business Card (Chemist)
flavor: It really is just a piece a paper with a phone number on it.

name: Business Card (Green)
flavor: A simple green business card with a phone number on it.

name: Class I Weapon Permit
desc: Increases the chance of gun buying customers to visit while in the display case. This permit will be revoked if Security Reputation is below 0.
flavor: A permit issued by the Warden allowing the holder to legally own and trade low level contraband firearms and ammunition.

name: Class II Weapon Permit
desc: Increases the chance of gun buying customers to visit while in the display case. This permit will be revoked if Security Reputation is below 30.
flavor: A permit issued by the Warden allowing the holder to legally own and trade mid level contraband weapons.

name: Class III Weapon Permit
desc: Increases the chance of gun buying customers to visit while in the display case. This permit will be revoked if Security Reputation is below 60.
flavor: A permit issued by the Warden allowing the holder to legally own and trade high level contraband weapons.

name: MBS Nerve Gas
desc: A highly toxic chemical weapon designed to disrupt the nervous system. Symptoms include: Respiratory failure, Convulsions, Loss of bodily functions, Unconsciousness and Death.
flavor: Handle with care.

name: Incident Slip
desc: A slip given by the Security Department after responding to an incident.

name: Food Stamp
desc: Redeem it at the Commissary to buy Food.
flavor: A prepaid card valid only to buy groceries. Part of a benefit program to assist the less fortunate in the Lower Levels.

flavor: Cybernetic Hand

name: Packaged Rib Sandwich
desc: A shelf stable limited edition sandwich consists of a restructured boneless pork patty shaped like a miniature rack of ribs. It has a cult following.

name: Scratcher Ticket
desc: Scratch off at least 2 matching symbols to win a prize!
flavor: A popular form of gambling in the Lower Levels. It is banned in the Upper Levels.

name: Gambler's Coin
flavor: A coin from a currency nobody remembers. They say it brings luck. Mostly, it scratches tickets faster.

name: Stack of Scratcher Tickets (5)
desc: Make sure to have enough space before unpacking it.
flavor: A stack of five lottery scratch cards.

name: Plasma Cartridge
desc: A compact, solid-state fuel cartridge used in Pulse Plasma Drives for space travel. Value varies wildly depending on the quality of the cartridge.

name: Aug Scanner
desc: Used to confirm the presence of a suspected Aug with 100% accuracy.
flavor: An energy hungry electromagnetic field detector fine tuned to pick up on the unique signatures of the Augmentation chip.

name: Blank Module
desc: A blank module. With the right machine, this could rewrite this into something useful.

name: Ruined Module
desc: A completely ruined module. Still holds some value as salvage. Can be broken down with a Screwdriver.

name: Corrupted Module
desc: A corrupted module. Can be restored with Electronic parts... and a little know-how.

name: Nutrifruit Hydroponic Module
desc: A module by pastel that allow Hydroponic System to yield more Nutrifruit when farming them. This module's unique effect doesn't affect other plants.

name: Dream Cap Neutralizer Hydroponic Module
desc: A module that neutralize all psychoactive propreties of Dream Cap when farming them, turning them into Meal Cap. This module's unique effect can be stacked but doesn't affect other plants.

name: Kotton Auto Loom Hydroponic Module
desc: A module that wove the Kotton Fiber into a fabric when farming them. This module's unique effect doesn't affect other plants.

name: Dream Cap Nightmare Hydroponic Module
desc: A module that concentrate psychoactive propreties of Dream Cap when farming them, turning them into Nightmare Cap, a toxic variant. This module's unique effect doesn't affect other plants.

name: Fillerweed Production Hydroponic Module
desc: A module will improve yield of Fillerweed at the cost of losing seeds. This module's unique effect doesn't affect other plants. This effect is not stackable

name: Hydroreed Filter Hydroponic Module
desc: A Module that allows the stem of a grown Hydroreed to be harvested and used as a water filter. Does not affect other plants.

name: Hydroponic Smuggler Module
desc: A module that remove the contrabands status of any growing seeds.

name: Metal Printer Module
desc: A module that allows the printer to use metal printer chips.

name: Neural Core Module (Uncapped)
desc: High-performance, but unstable, and illegal. An AI core housed inside a system module. These type of AI core have a tendency to go rogue.

name: Alarm Transmitter Module
desc: Currently Transmitting To: {0} Transmitting twice to the same faction has no additional effect.
flavor: This module will transmit security camera footage captured by your cameras to the set faction.

name: Furnace Module (Blast)
desc: A special Module that modifies the Furnace, allowing {0} Materials to create {1} Metal Ingots (at slightly lower purity). Does not stack.

name: Furnace Module (Junk Processing)
desc: A special Module that modifies the Furnace, allowing Junk to be processed into Scrap Metal.

name: Neural Core Module (Capped)
desc: AI Cores are illegal onboard the Station. This unit features integrated safeguards that curb rogue behavior, while throttling its performance.

name: Cryptographic Desequencer Chip (Security)
desc: A module that allows the Cryptographic Desequencer to write Security permissions to Blank Keycards.

name: Cryptographic Desequencer Chip (Command)
desc: A module that allows the Cryptographic Desequencer to write Command permissions to Blank Keycards.

name: Cryptographic Desequencer Chip (Medical)
desc: A module that allows the Cryptographic Desequencer to write Medical permissions to Blank Keycards.

name: Cryptographic Desequencer Chip (Engineering)
desc: A module that allows the Cryptographic Desequencer to write Engineering permissions to Blank Keycards.

name: Cryptographic Desequencer Chip (Supply)
desc: A module that allows the Cryptographic Desequencer to write Supply permissions to Blank Keycards.

name: Cryptographic Desequencer Chip (Service)
desc: A module that allows the Cryptographic Desequencer to write Service permissions to Blank Keycards.

name: Module Extractor (Basic)
desc: Allows you to extract stuck modules from machines without breaking them. Has {0} uses. Can be partially refurbished with Electronic Parts.

name: Module Extractor (Advanced)
desc: Allows you to extract stuck modules from machines without breaking them. This advanced model will not degrade with use.

name: Module Bay Expansion Kit
desc: A one time use kit that will allow you to expand Machine's Module capacity. This kit is not compatible with Chemical or other special Machines.

name: Chemical Equipment Module
desc: Require a module extractor to remove once installed. A special module that can improve the Blender, the Heating Plate and the Chem Finisher

name: Makeshift Storage Bay
desc: A improvised storage bay for storing items. Can't store other containers or machines.

name: Storage Bay
desc: A standard bay for storing items.

name: Storage Bay (Extended)
desc: An expanded bay for storing items.

name: Storage Bay Expansion Kit
desc: Use it on a Storage Bay to add two storage tabs, or on an Extended Storage Bay to add one.

name: Machine Bay
desc: A standard bay for storing machines.

name: Machine Bay (Expanded)
desc: A expanded bay for storing machines.

name: Gunsmith Storage Bay
desc: A specialized storage bay for storing firearms and modifications. Can't store other containers or machines.

name: Chemist Storage Bay
desc: A specialized storage bay for storing chemistry equipments and supplies. Can't store other containers or machines.

name: Mini Smuggler's Bay
desc: A disguised storage bay designed to hide its contents from inspection. This one is mini.

name: Smuggler's Bay
desc: A small disguised storage bay designed to hide its contents from inspection.

name: Smuggler's Bay (Modified)
desc: A disguised storage bay designed to hide its contents from inspection. This one has been modified to allow for more storage.

name: Screwdriver
desc: While carrying this, scavenging in the Dumping Grounds yields 10% more Screws.
flavor: The humble screwdriver, a common fixture of the spare drawers of citizens in the Upper and Lower Levels alike.

name: Plasma Cutter
desc: Can be used to salvage Scrap Metal by disassembling broken machines. While carrying this, scavenging in the Dumping Grounds yields 10% more Scrap Metal.
flavor: High frequency ignition plasma cutter. Manufactured for guaranteed stability, and a fast, strong and smooth cut.

name: Wire Cutter
desc: Can be used to salvage Wire by disassembling broken machines. While carrying this, scavenging in the Dumping Grounds yields 10% more Wire.
flavor: Spring action ensures good leverage and reduces strain on the user, while the soft rubber handles give good grip and comfort.

name: Toolbox
desc: Holds tools. Press 1-9 on the keyboard to equip the stored item.
flavor: Quite robust.

name: Labeler
desc: Used to edit the label of an item.

name: Blue Labeler
desc: Used to rename an item.

name: Intake Hopper
desc: Can be linked to an Outlet Hopper and configured to send the items of its inventory into the Outlet Hopper's inventory every night. Use it on an Outlet Hopper to link them, double-click to set it up.

name: Outlet Hopper
desc: Receives the items sent by its linked Intake Hoppers into its inventory every night. Use it on an Intake Hopper to link them, double-click to run them now.

name: Magnifying Glass
desc: Used to inspect certain items more closely.

name: Disposable Turbo Booster
desc: A tool that can immediately power machines that require time to operate. Ensure the target machine has all the necessary inputs before using. Consumed upon use.

name: Advanced Turbo Booster
desc: A tool that can immediately power machines that require time to operate. Ensure the target machine has all the necessary inputs before using. Recharges over time. This advanced version will not be consumed upon use.

name: Hypertech Turbo Booster
desc: A turbo booster powered by an Energy Cell. It charges every cycle and banks spare charge. Once charged, it instantly completes a machine's current cycle.

name: Mind Reprogrammer
desc: Can remove and add certain perks. Consume Electronic Parts (Hypertech) to charge it. The device needs time to reset after each use.

name: Water Neon Sign
desc: A neon sign that, when placed in the Display Case, will attract customers willing to sell Water.

name: Portable XRay Scanner
desc: Can be use to see what's inside sealed containers.

name: Expedition Sign
desc: Place it in the display case to attract new hirelings for hire and current hirelings ready for expedition.

name: Yeast
flavor: A versatile yeast culture with countless uses, from leavening bread to brewing. For winemaking, it speeds up fermentation and improves the quality of the brew.

name: Super Yeast
flavor: A highly potent, all-purpose yeast culture prized across countless crafts. For winemaking, it dramatically speeds up the fermentation process.

name: Synthetic Yeast
desc: An illegal substance that can be used instead of yeast to cheaply produce mildly carcinogenic wine. Requires only water.

name: Yeast Bioreactor
desc: An infinite source of yeast. Will be returned to inventory when fermentation starts instead of being consumed.
flavor: A self-sustaining culture vat that continuously regrows its own yeast.

name: Wine Bottle
desc: A fancy glass bottle used for fermenting wine. This one has a integrated airlock.

name: BloomBerry
flavor: A sweet berry modified for hydroponic growth. While not particularly filling, it's one of few fruits that is accessible in the Lower Levels. Good for making wine.
